apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

*Accounts need a Suwayomi server with multi-user support, which is not in a Suwayomi release yet. Everything else below works on any current server.*

- Added multi-user accounts so each person can sign in to a Suwayomi server with their own library, downloads and permissions (@aaronbamblett)
- Added an **Account** screen showing your role and permissions, with **Change password** and **Sign out** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added user management so administrators can create accounts and issue a **Registration code** or **Recovery code** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Inactive account downloads** to remove downloads another account left on this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Keep recently-read chapters downloaded** to fetch the next chapter as you cross a chapter boundary (@yohanim)
- Added a **Library update errors** screen that opens from the failed-update notification and lists series that failed during the last library update, each with a **Migrate** button (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Select below** to the chapter multi-select menu (@yohanim)
- Added options to stop keeping chapters downloaded and remove downloaded chapters in the offline picker when selecting multiple library series (@yohanim)
- Completed the Chinese translations for zh, zh-Hans and zh-Hant (@AITNR)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Added confirmation whenever you delete chapters in bulk, with a warning when they will also be removed from this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed the library update button to a stop button while an update is running (@aaronbamblett)
- Replaced the Updates summary sheet with the **Library update errors** screen (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Added a spinner that appears as soon as you tap **Download to server** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Retry all** to the Downloads **Server** tab whenever any download has failed (@aaronbamblett)
- Updated the Browse tab's update count after installing, updating or uninstalling an extension (@aaronbamblett)
- Updated the Updates list to show new entries as a background library check finishes, preserving your place in the list (@yohanim)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed background downloads skipping series past the first page of a large library (@yohanim)
- Fixed **Keep next N unread** downloading chapters behind your furthest-read position (@yohanim)
- Fixed bulk keep-rule changes only taking effect for overnight downloads after the app was next sent to the background (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed series remaining scheduled for overnight downloads after you removed them from this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed bulk keep-rule changes downloading chapters to this device without storing them on the server (@yohanim)
- Fixed inconsistent handling of releases with the same chapter number when marking chapters as read, deleting them or navigating in the reader (@SuperMario22922)
- Fixed overnight downloads stopping when the access token expired (@yohanim)
- Fixed downloads restarting when the notification panel was closed (@yohanim)
- Fixed failures when changing the server address while downloads were registered (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed downloaded chapters being fetched again and storage use being miscounted at desktop launch (@yohanim)
- Fixed background catch-up never retrying chapters it had given up on (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed source filters appearing partially selected before you tapped them (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed tapping a queued or active device download failing to cancel it (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed bulk chapter deletion doing nothing in the web app (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed getting stuck in an unauthorised library by adding a **Signed out** screen that opens connection settings (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Library failing to refresh when opened during an ongoing library update (@yohanim)
- Fixed signing in appearing to hang forever, by moving the offline library into its account instead of copying every downloaded chapter (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed blank labels throughout the German translation (@DattatreyaReddy)

- Fixed offline downloads and reading progress not carrying over when the library moved into its account (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Downloads queue header flickering on a slow or unreachable server (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed kept series being dropped from the device when a library timestamp was misread (@yohanim)

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-x64.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://suwayomi.github.io/Suwayomi-Tsumiru/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru
```

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
